property_summary: createArtFromFactory maps a fresh artId to the current tokenIdCounter, returns that tokenId, sets the reverse mapping, and increments tokenIdCounter by exactly 1.
createArtFromFactory on a fresh artId returns the current tokenIdCounter and links the artId and that tokenId in both directions.
For a fresh artId, createArtFromFactory returns a token id tid such that artId maps to tid and tid maps back to artId.
For a fresh artId, createArtFromFactory returns the current tokenIdCounter and registers the artId→tokenId mapping.
Each successful createArtFromFactory call allocates sequential token ids and keeps the artId<->tokenId mappings consistent with tokenIdCounter.
After initialization, for any token id and sale price, royaltyInfo returns the default 5% royalty (salePrice/20) paid to the protocol fee destination.
After initialization, royaltyInfo(tokenId, salePrice) returns the default 5% royalty (salePrice * 500 / 10000) with the protocol fee destination as receiver.
Once paused, any createArtFromFactory call reverts, while pause()/unPause() by the owner toggles the paused() flag.
transferOwnership only sets pendingOwner without changing owner(), and a wrong caller cannot acceptOwnership; ownership transfers only when the pending owner accepts.
